Name: Viconia NPC
Author: pseudodiego
Description:
Hi.

This is a mod that I have planned for some time, and finally I finded someone that did a portrait for her(TheMexYeti).

The Stardew Valley world have Wizards, monsters, dwarfs... so why not Drows?, and since i was going to add a Drow, might as well go for my favourite one: Viconia DeVir from Baldur's Gate 2.

The aim of this mod is to get her into the stardew valley world, adapting her story to the SV setting. 

Right now she only have 3 events and a bunch of dialogues, but I plan to include almost all her events from BG2 into the mod, as well as some new ones. Same for her dialogue and for the other NPC referencing the Drow or her.
She will be marriageable in the future too, and my other mod Xtardew Valley will add adult content for her.

[b]Viconia will appear in the quarry mine entrance after you have seen her first event, which trigger in the second year of the game when you enter the normal mine entrance between 9:00 and 19:00.[/b]

Her next event trigger in the mountain when you're at five heart with her between 22:10 and 24:00 and the last event trigger in the mountain between 20:00 and 22:00 when you have seen her previous event.

Right now the mod assume that the farmer is Male, but from 0.2 it will work for a female farmer too.

Leave any feedback or bug reporting that you might have here or at the Xtardew Valley [url=https://discord.gg/gFUjuJT]discord[/url]. Thanks!.
